tooling.message:
docs(site): the workshop page shows a block's technology instead of a kind of its own

## Intent

x-kind repeated what the architecture already says: the technology of a building block and the protocol of an interface. Use those instead.

## Key changes

- A box names what the element is built with: the technology of a block, the protocol of an interface.
- x-kind and the list of kinds are gone; the boxes of a phase follow the order of the chapters.
- The technology is a muted line under the title, which keeps the icons on the title's line.
